units.source_text: 且说那位萤兵部卿亲王，悼亡后至今尚未续弦，还是鳏居在家。

en.t: Now Prince Hotaru, the Hyobukyo prince, had not remarried since his wife died and was still living at home as a widower.

units.source_text: 以前曾经追求玉鬘及三公主，均告失败。

en.t: In the past he had pursued Tamakazura and the Third Princess, but both attempts had failed.

units.source_text: 自己觉得处世没有面子，徒然惹人讥笑。

en.t: He felt that he had lost face in society and had only invited people's ridicule for nothing.

units.source_text: 长此孤居独处，岂能甘心情愿！

en.t: How could he be content to go on living alone like this forever?

units.source_text: 便发心向真木柱求婚。

en.t: So he made up his mind to propose marriage to Makibashira.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王说道：“这还有什么话可说呢！

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo said, "What more is there to say about this?

units.source_text: 凡是欲为女子造福，最好是送她入宫，其次是嫁给亲王。

en.t: If one wants to secure a woman's happiness, the best thing is to send her to court, and the next best is to marry her to a prince.

units.source_text: 今世之人，爱把女儿嫁给有财有势的臣民，自以为得计，实乃下等见识。”

en.t: People nowadays like to marry their daughters to wealthy and powerful subjects and think it a clever plan, but that is truly a low way of thinking."

units.source_text: 便不教萤兵部卿亲王遭受多大困难，一口答应了他。

en.t: Thus he did not make Prince Hotaru endure much difficulty and accepted his proposal at once.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王一点苦头也不曾吃，一拍即合，反而觉得兴味索然。

en.t: Prince Hotaru had not suffered the slightest hardship, and because the match came together so easily, he found it rather dull.

units.source_text: 但对方总是声望高贵的人，这边不便中途翻悔，便和真木柱定了情。

en.t: But since the other side was, after all, a family of high reputation and rank, he could not very well change his mind halfway, and so he became pledged to Makibashira.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王非常重视这位外孙女婿。

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo placed great value on this husband of his granddaughter.

units.source_text: 这位亲王有许多女儿，婚事都不称心，受了不少闲气，已成惊弓之鸟。

en.t: This prince had many daughters, and none of their marriages had turned out as he wished; after suffering many vexations, he had become thoroughly wary.

units.source_text: 但这外孙女的婚事，他又不能放弃不管。

en.t: But he could not abandon this granddaughter's marriage and leave it unattended.

units.source_text: 他说：“她的母亲是个神经错乱的人，病势一年重似一年。

en.t: He said, "Her mother is mentally disturbed, and her illness grows worse year by year.

units.source_text: 她的父亲呢，因为她不曾遵命前往依附后母，所以不喜欢她，把她弃置不顾。

en.t: As for her father, because she did not obey him and go attach herself to her stepmother, he dislikes her and has cast her aside without concern.

units.source_text: 这女孩真可怜啊！”

en.t: The poor girl is truly pitiable!"

units.source_text: 因此外孙女儿洞房里装饰、布置等事，他都亲自策划照料，万事尽心竭力，实在难为了他。

en.t: For that reason, he personally planned and looked after the decorations, furnishings, and other matters for his granddaughter's bridal chamber, putting all his heart into everything and taking great pains.

units.source_text: 岂知萤兵部卿亲王怀念已故的前妻，心中时刻不忘。

en.t: But who could have known that Prince Hotaru was still grieving for his late former wife and never forgot her for a moment?

units.source_text: 他只想娶一个相貌肖似前妻的人为继室。

en.t: He only wanted to take as his second wife someone whose appearance closely resembled his former wife.

units.source_text: 这真木柱相貌原也长得不坏，但他认为并不肖似前妻。

en.t: Makibashira was certainly not bad-looking, but he felt that she did not resemble his former wife.

units.source_text: 大约是心中不满之故，把和真木柱同居当作一件苦事。

en.t: Probably because he was dissatisfied at heart, he regarded living with Makibashira as a hardship.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王大为失望，不胜忧虑。

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo was deeply disappointed and overcome with worry.

units.source_text: 母亲虽然神经病得厉害，但当她清醒之时，也慨叹世事多艰，觉得前途绝望。

en.t: Although the mother's mental illness was severe, when she was clear-headed she too lamented the hardships of the world and felt despair about the future.
